title: Yen support: Japan services PMI hits five-month high as inflation strengthens BOJ hike case
description: The combination of stronger growth and near record cost pass through is the key signal here for BOJ policy watchers, and Fiddes explicitly linked the data to a strengthening case for another rate hike. This is a yen supportive data point on its face, since it reinforces the narrative of accelerating domestic inflation pressure alongside decent growth momentum, a combination that gives the BOJ more room to tighten. title: China's RatingDog services PMI beats strongly as domestic demand offsets soft export growth
description: Today's RatingDog services beat completes the week's China data set and reinforces the pattern already seen in the manufacturing PMIs, private and export oriented surveys running hotter than the state weighted official readings. This divergence is worth tracking rather than resolving in either direction, since it likely reflects genuine differences in panel composition, private surveys skew toward smaller, more externally exposed firms, rather than one series being right and the other wrong. title: RITS Consultation and Retail CBDC Update
description: Media Release Number 2026-24: The RBA today launched a consultation on the Role of RITS in Supporting Settlement in a Tokenised Ecosystem. As highlighted in Project Acacia, tokenisation has the potential to enhance the efficiency, functionality and resilience of Australia’s wholesale financial markets.
